profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer for Lexis Nexus Risk through Swoon Staffing.
Experience in Full-Stack .Net Development, AI-Driven software development, enterprise systems.
Based in Suwanee, GA
Context engineering is the future.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built an auto-documenting wiki system that pulls from 25+ repositories using GitHub Actions and strategic handoffs to GitHub Copilot, reducing manual documentation effort across the team

Developed ETL tools to aggregate GraphQL queries of GitHub Issues, automate data delivery to internal shared storage, and design PowerBI dashboards for cross-team reporting using that data. 

Picked up ECL (Enterprise Control Language), a proprietary language specific to the HPCC platform, within the first few weeks of the contract to contribute meaningfully across the organization.

Led internal discussions on using LLMs as coding agents, covering practical topics like context management, preventing context rot, and getting reliable output from AI-assisted development workflows using the principles of context engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, maintained, and delivered 20+ cloud-native microservices supporting 2,000+ internal users at GM, maintaining 99.9% uptime across multi-region Azure deployments, On-Premise Kubernetes Clusters, and Cloud Foundry instances. Primary focus on .Net/Angular and supporting apps across many languages, libraries, and architectures. 

Mentored Software developers on my team to maintain best practices in software, communication, and leadership.

Was performing front lines research for Context-Driven development utilizing AI agents in 2025; in efforts to deliver required legacy migrations and greenfield apps.

TECH STACK:
Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core | Cloud: Azure | Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, jQuery | Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Bicep, Terraform | DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTelemetry
positions.insights: Skills: Reliability · Software Design · AI Software Development · Communication · TypeScript · ASP.NET · Angular · SQL · Microsoft Azure · Cloud Foundry

company.name: PATH - PRESERVING ARCHIVING & TEACHING HIPHOP INC

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
• Transition an in-person Hip Hop academy to virtual learning and introduce instructors to new technologies.
• Provide insight and instruction for all technical challenges.
• Manage a live-streamed event to showcase the students work at the end of their courses.
• Manage WordPress pages and update the website for ADA accessibility.

positions.title: Music Instructor and Intern
positions.description:
• Instruct students from ages 13 to 20 in producing Hip-hop music in various DAWs (Digital Audio Workspace).
• Prepare students for a seasonal showcase that is crafted by the students and curated by instructors.
• Manage a constructive environment, targeting youth's motivation and drive for their artforms.
• Perform on behalf of PATH, showcase original work, and design original sounds to be cued and performed live.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
( Remote Position )
Build the Reiform website in an Agile setting using React and TypeScript.
• Balance requirements, UX, and deadlines to get the most business value out of a short timeframe.
• Make reusable React components, that are codified to Reiform, and can be utilized in other areas of the web UX.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Reliability · Web Pages · Communication

positions.title: VR Designer
positions.locationName: Clinton County, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Design an integrated VR (Virtual Reality) orchestra simulation to take control as the conductor.
• Implement scripts in C# for audio manipulation and recognition of Joy-Con movements
• Collaborate effectively, through a 4-month timeline, with a team of four in Unity.
• Deployed the product for a professor as a research and practice tool for conductors at Hamilton College.
• Presented project for Thesis Evaluation and Educause XR presentation

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Music; Computer Science and Music

honors.title: Emerson Grant
honors.description: Inspired to create an all-Hamilton album, musician Anthony Reyes ’20 obtained an Emerson grant from the College to spend the summer collaborating on the project with jazz bassist and composer “Doc” Woods, the Leonard C. Ferguson Professor of Music. Reyes, a music and computer science major, aims to capture Hamilton’s music-making, project-making culture.

projects.title: VR Orchestra Simulator
projects.description:
•	Created an integrated VR (Virtual Reality) orchestra simulation to take control as the conductor.
• Implemented scripts in C# for audio manipulation and recognition of joycon movements
•	Worked with a team of four in Unity, maintaining effective communication and division-of-labor through a 4-month timeline.
•	Prepared the product for a professor in the music department as a research tool and developmental asset for conductors at Hamilton College.
•	Presented project for Thesis Evaluation and Educause XR presentation

projects.title: Duality - Emerson Grant
projects.description: Received an Emerson Grant from Hamilton College to complete a Jazz/Electronic album in the Summer of 2018.
